text:
Market today: Higher yields are the clear driver, hitting growth names hard. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially leveraged ETFs, feels this pain amplified by margin.

Your holdings: SOXL (-29.29%) and SPAL (-17.02%) are the clear SELL/TRIM candidates needing attention. They are leveraged and decaying, and the market environment is punishing them.

Watch: The broader market's reaction to continued yield pressure.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged losers and protecting capital in this environment.
plays: Trim SOXL: Given the -29.29% PnL and leveraged decay, consider reducing exposure.
Trim SPAL: Similar to SOXL, the -17.02% PnL and leveraged nature warrant a trim.
Consider SMCI: Currently HOLD at 2.42% PnL. If it breaks below its stop of 37.3, consider trimming.
